'''Tunnel C-21''' was located beneath the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Ariana]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Garos IV]]. It was the rendezvous point for [[Alexandra Winger]] and [[Team Five]] before their mission to rescue [[Scat]] from detention in the [[Imperial Headquarters (Garos IV)|Imperial Headquarters]].
